translator_notes: Origin unclear; it reads as a modern composed song but I cannot name an author. 'лажовно' and the line 'Сто да ги имам' (a hundred what, years or lives) are my reading.

lines.cyr: Кога те видов, кога те сретнав,
lines.lat: Koga te vidov, koga te sretnav,
lines.en: When I saw you, when I met you,

lines.cyr: за таква жена, за таква љубов
lines.lat: za takva žena, za takva ljubov
lines.en: for such a woman, for such a love
even a hundred years are little.

lines.cyr: Што сакаш повеќе од една песна
lines.lat: Što sakaš poveḱe od edna pesna
lines.en: What more do you want than a song

lines.cyr: Што сакаш повеќе од една љубов,
lines.lat: Što sakaš poveḱe od edna ljubov,
lines.en: What more do you want than a love,

lines.cyr: Сега се плашам искрен да бидам,
lines.lat: Sega se plašam iskren da bidam,
lines.en: Now I am afraid to be honest,
so as not to offend you, dear.

lines.cyr: Сто да ги имам, сите ги давам
lines.lat: Sto da gi imam, site gi davam
lines.en: If I had a hundred, I would give them all
just to look at you once.
